question: Do surprise onside kicks get recovered more than expected late-game onside kicks?
answer: Yes, 25% vs 9% (2015-23), but below the ~32% break-even for an early onside. Net WPA not different from zero.
findings: Q1-Q3 surprise onside, kicking-team WPA -0.6 pts (-1.8 to +0.6, n=54); normal kickoff -0.04.
Break-even recovery rate for a Q1-Q3 surprise onside: about 32%.
method: Onside = kickoff described as onside. Expected = Q4 with the kicker trailing; surprise = all others. WPA compared with normal Q1-Q3 kickoffs within 14 points, game bootstrap CIs. Teams pick spots, so rates are upper bounds.
data: nflverse play-by-play, 2015 to 2026 wk 8, 691 onside kicks.
split_check: Surprise recovery 28% in 2015-18 (n=32), 21% in 2019-23 (n=24); expected stays near 9%.
